title: Correct self-contained D TV update
notes: Corrects the 0.13.9 distribution error: Downloader now serves the upgrade-compatible app.opentv.stremiolab package rather than the plain upstream variant. Fresh installs import the 25,398-channel bundled playlist directly from the APK and only mark setup complete after the catalogue is stored, so an interrupted first launch retries instead of remaining empty. Existing D TV installations receive a one-time non-destructive catalogue and guide refresh while preserving favourites, folders, hidden channels, history, settings, add-ons and logins. Android still requires its standard Install confirmation because ordinary sideloaded apps cannot silently replace themselves.
